title: Warm Buttery Jamaican Chicken Paella
description: A flavorful and aromatic Jamaican dish featuring chicken, natural yoghurt, and spices, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe is low-glycemic-friendly and can be prepared in under an hour.
instructions: Heat the butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the jerk seasoning to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the rice to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the skillet, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the yoghurt and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Season the paella with salt to taste.
Garnish with scallions and serve hot.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
